subject: How change font size in strip

messages.author: a14c99912d569cb9
messages.subject: How change font size in strip
parts:
This is a very basic question, but I have been stumbling around
Hadley's pdf without success, so here goes.

All I want to do is reduce the size of the font in the strips which
are produced with the following code.

qplot(v0001, ..density.., data=df, geom = "histogram", binwidth=1)+
theme_bw() + facet_wrap(~ nresidence, nrow = 4)

Help would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Greg Blevins

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: How change font size in strip
parts:
Try this,

library(ggplot2)

data(diamonds)
dsmall = diamonds[sample(1:nrow(diamonds), 15),]

p =
qplot(carat, price, data=dsmall) + facet_grid( .~clarity)

p + opts(strip.text.x = theme_text(size=5))

HTH,

baptiste

messages.subject: Re: How change font size in strip
parts:
your plot seems to be called P (capital letter), but you can also
append opts() at the end of your code,

P = qplot() + ... + opts()


baptiste
